name: Documentation reader
applicability: Read a small reference grouped into named sections.
avoid_when: An article layout is not a full-text search engine or a generated API contract.

responsive.wide: Preserve task context and readable data density.
responsive.narrow: Stack secondary regions; constrain table scrolling to its own region; retain all essential actions.
